text:
Maya R.: Heads up — our weekly eng sync on the calendar switched to PST after DST rolled in. Several folks in EMEA are seeing it at the wrong local time and the Zoom link rotated to a different meeting ID.
Samir K.: Ugh. Google recurring events can flip timezone on organizer DST changes. Organizer's timezone is currently set to America/Los_Angeles.
Maya R.: Exactly. A bunch of people joined 1 hour late today. We also had the Zoom link rotate (new meeting ID). Not great for RFC reviews.
Juan C.: Is the meeting created with a personal Zoom link or auto-generated each recurrence?
Priya S.: Auto-generated. Zoom default is new meeting per occurrence unless PMI is used.
Elena M.: Proposal: switch the recurring event to UTC timezone, put a fixed PMI in the conference field, and add a short event description with local times. That should stop the rotating link + DST drift.
Maya R.: I like UTC. Also can we add an explicit line like "Local time examples: 09:00PT / 12:00ET / 18:00CET" in the description so people don't need to convert.
Samir K.: Ops option: create the event from the shared service account (redwood-eng-calendar@redwood.com) so organizer tz is stable. I can create and transfer ownership if folks are ok.
Juan C.: Will that affect calendar notifications or ownership semantics for edits? I just want to ensure calendar invite updates still reach attendees.
Priya S.: Ownership transfer is fine. Notifications still go to attendees. Just make sure the organizer is a group/service account in GSuite.
Maya R.: Can someone make the change before next week's RFC review? Agenda: 1) RFC: KV cache eviction (20m) 2) Design: batching gateway (15m) 3) Triage: flakey perf tests (10m)
Elena M.: I'll create a new recurring event under the eng shared calendar in UTC, set the PMI, update the description with local times + dial-in, and ping the channel when done. ETA: today EOD.
calendar-bot: Updated event "Weekly Eng Sync" created by redwood-eng-calendar@ — recurrence preserved, timezone set to UTC, meeting link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (PMI)
Maya R.: Thanks Elena — appreciate it. If anyone sees a stray invite in their calendar, accept the new one and decline the old to avoid duplicates.
Samir K.: Also adding a permanent agenda template and a link to the RFC doc in the event description helps async reviewers. I'll paste the template in #eng-docs after lunch.
Priya S.: small reminder — when creating recurring events please avoid "Floating" timezone in GCal (it causes conversions). Use a fixed tz or UTC.
Elena M.: Done — pinged everyone and updated description with agenda + RFC link. Let me know if the Zoom PMI needs rotation later.
Maya R.: Perfect. Closing the loop — thanks all :thumbsup:
